A '''boomerang''' was an object that was popular on many backwaters of the galaxy. A handcrafted weapon favored by hunters and trappers on [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]], it required some skill to throw correctly. When used properly, the boomerang would strike a target or spin around mid-air and return to the user. Once retrieved, a boomerang could be reused indefinitely until lost or damaged.<ref name="NoP" />

Boomerangs were symbolically similar in appearance to a [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|J-type diplomatic barge]].<ref name="AOTCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The boomerang is mentioned briefly in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] by [[R. A. Salvatore]], in which the ship carrying [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] decoy [[Cordé/Legends|Cordé]] is likened to this object.
